rules.statement: For section 408 of the Civil Procedure Code to apply, it must be clearly established that the parties intended for an agreement or compromise to be embodied in a decree.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion the judgment cannot be supported. It is fundamentally necessary before section 408 can be applied that it should be clearly established that what is put forward as an agreement or compromise of an action by the parties was intended by them to be such."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 408 of the Civil Procedure Code
